name: Botanic
description: Unlocks [color=#31E920]Growth Mode[/color]. Left click harvests ripe crops in a 3x3; right click's pollen grows plants and poisons enemies. Sneak-Beam tills. You never trample farmland.

badge.name: Gardener
badge.description: Unlocks [color=#31E920]Growth Mode[/color]. Left click harvests ripe crops in a 3x3; right click's pollen grows plants and poisons enemies. Sneak-Beam tills. You never trample farmland.

commons.name: Regrowth
commons.description: Harvests replant themselves. Spend 1 [b]Matter[/b] to replant them half-grown.

adept.name: Overgrowth
adept.description: Harvests spread through every connected ripe crop of the same kind.

master.name: Groundskeeper
master.description: Sneak-Beam works as shears, on sheep and hives too.

master.name: Herder
master.description: Sneak-Beam feeds animals from your inventory.

grandmaster.name: Cross-Pollination
grandmaster.description: Harvesting grows nearby young crops a stage.
